DOKUMEN RAHASIA — jangan commit, unggah, atau bagikan dokumen hasil ekstraksi. 
## 1. GitHub Actions secrets
Buka repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions. 
### RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64

Nama Secret:
```text
RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64
```

Nilai Secret:
```text

```

### STORE_PASSWORD

Nama Secret:
```text
STORE_PASSWORD
```

Nilai Secret:
```text
Fm;^29{<JS/~kk9]
```

### KEY_PASSWORD

Nama Secret:
```text
KEY_PASSWORD
```

Nilai Secret:
```text
Fm;^29{<JS/~kk9]
```

### KEY_ALIAS

Nama Secret:
```text
KEY_ALIAS
```

Nilai Secret:
```text
upload
```
